question: When and to whom was this same question previously posed by the speaker?
premises: The same matter was asked formerly.
The asking occurred at the beginning of a cosmic cycle.
The speaker posed it to Viṣṇu.
inference: Therefore the speaker states that this very question was formerly asked by him to Viṣṇu at the beginning of the kalpa.
uncertainties: The form 'pṛṣṭhaṃ' is taken as related to 'pṛṣṭam' (asked) based on context, but the surface is preserved as given.
plain_english: This very thing was formerly asked by me to Viṣṇu at the beginning of the cosmic cycle.
